messages:
emily: Heads up — draft rate plan change (v2026.4) added a new rule for SKU POC-SK1. Field is asking whether POC usage should count toward annual commit tiers. EMEA AEs have calls tomorrow; need guidance ASAP.

raj: Uploaded the draft and a short decision matrix: https://redwood.internal/rateplans/v2026.4-draft. Key Q: do we count POC consumption for commit credits or treat as non-committal trial usage?

sam: From SE side — two recent POCs would fall below threshold at renewal if we don't count them. Customers expect POC credits if there's a signed SOW and a PO attached.

maya: Deal desk preference: we can allow conditional counting but need explicit language and a one-time approval process. Proposal: count POC usage toward commit only if SOW signed AND PO received within 30 days of POC start. Tag deals with #poc-exception for manual review.

emily: That conditional sounds workable. Can you draft the clause? Customers want predictable pricing when we ask them to deploy real workloads during POC.

raj: Draft clause (quick): `If the customer signs an SOW that references committed units and provides a purchase order within 30 days of the POC start date, usage recorded under POC-SK1 will be applied to the customer's annual committed units for the contract term.` Thoughts?

sam: Minor tweak: require that the SOW explicitly references the committed SKU and the start/end dates for the POC. Otherwise ops/backfill confusion.

maya: Agreed. Also add a rollback/appeal path: deal desk can revoke credit if misuse is discovered within 90 days. Add to policy doc and tag as "temporary exception workflow" for v2026 rollout.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Rate plan v2026.4 draft published by raj at 2026-03-15 14:02 UTC.

emily: Next steps: maya — can you add the clause to the internal policy and create a templated approval form? raj — please update the draft with the exact language and send to legal for a quick review. sam — flag any open POCs that would be impacted. I need a firm answer by EOD PT so AEs can proceed. :pray:

maya: On it — will create the approval form and start a deal-desk queue item. ETA 5pm PT.

raj: Will update draft + ping legal. If legal flags material changes we'll loop you in.

sam: I'll assemble the list of 3 affected POCs and post here in a separate thread.

emily: Thanks team. If we get a fast legal thumbs up, we'll ship the temporary exception in the v2026.4 patch notes and add a short blurb to the AE playbook.
